test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Bollywood choreographers has won the 63rd National Film Awards in the category of Best Choreography for his/her excellent work in the Hindi movie ‘Bajirao Mastani’ ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Remo D’Souza**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Remo D'Souza **has been working in Bollywood for a very long time and has choreographed many iconic dance numbers.
 
• Most recently, he choreographed the very popular **Deewani Mastani** and **Pinga** from Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Bajirao Mastani.
 
• Both the dances looked fabulous and with that **Remo** won the most iconic award so far.
 
• He won the **63rd National Film Awards** for the Best Choreography for Deewani Mastani's song - Bajirao Mastani.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ganesh Acharya**__ is an Indian choreographer, film director, and actor who prominently works in Hindi films. He has choreographed for a variety of films, including Bodyguard and Singham.
 
• **__Prabhu Deva__ **is an Indian dance choreographer, film director, producer, and actor who has worked predominantly in Tamil, Hindi, and Telugu language films. In a career spanning 32 years, he has performed and designed a wide range of dancing styles and has garnered two National Film Awards for Best Choreography.
 
• __**Farah Khan Kunder**__ is an Indian film director, film producer, actress, dancer and choreographer who works predominantly in Hindi films.
